metadata.title: When you don’t even try but Valorant just gifts you 2 kills like ‘Here ya go’
metadata.description:
Aim was definitely on vacation.
Enemy probably uninstalling out of respect.
Valorant logic: handing out freebies with no questions asked.
Click if your aim ghosts but kills still happen!

Hit like if your aim checked out but your kills didn’t!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
